# Proposal for Doshi: depth fallback = multi-row `gpu_lidar` (experimental)

**Status:** PROPOSAL, 2026-10-04. Simulation only; not in the baseline.

**Why:** the baseline `depth_camera` crashes `gz sim` on Ogre2/Metal (KNOWN ISSUE, `docs/uav-physics-baseline.md`). A `gpu_lidar` with several rows renders fine on the same backend and gives a depth-like 3D scan.

**What exists:** `simulation/experimental/depth_lidar_diagnostic.sdf`, generated by `tools/make_depth_lidar_diagnostic.py` (a `wall` world, vehicle held fixed at 1 m, **never fly it**). Not in `simulation/diagnostics/` on purpose, so the regression does not pick it up.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Sensor | `depth_lidar`, `gpu_lidar`, on `base_link` at x +0.12 m (the RGB camera mount), facing +x |
| Beams | 64 (azimuth) × 16 (elevation) = 1024 per scan |
| Field of view | 60° × 30° (azimuth ±30°, elevation ±15°) |
| Range / noise / rate | 0.1–12 m, gaussian σ 0.01 m, 10 Hz |
| Topics | `/airmouse/depth_lidar` (`gz.msgs.LaserScan`, row-major: 16 rows of 64, bottom row first, positive vertical angle = up) and `/airmouse/depth_lidar/points` (`gz.msgs.PointCloudPacked`, sensor frame, x forward) |

**Verification** (`python3 tools/verify_depth_lidar.py`, log `logs/sim-step3-depth-lidar/`): all 1024 beams agree with an analytic ray cast against the floor and a wall (median error 3.2 mm, max 17.5 mm; return / no-return identical), grid and field of view exact, 9.1 Hz measured on the wall clock, point-cloud topic publishes. No `gz sim` crash with a subscriber (the failure of the depth camera). **Not verified:** speed under SITL load, behaviour in the maze, and the point cloud's field layout in ROS.

**ROS side:** `ros_gz_bridge` converts only single-row `LaserScan`, so bridge the point cloud (`PointCloud2`, entry commented out in `config/ros_gz_bridge.yaml`). A depth image can be derived from it if the SLAM needs one (`depth = x`, pinhole with 64×16 pixels at 0.95° × 2.0° spacing; resolution is far below the 640×480 depth camera).

**Decision for Doshi:** is a 64×16 cloud enough for the SLAM? If not, options are more rows/beams (cost grows with beam count; none of these larger sizes tested) or a different sensor model. Tell me the resolution/FOV/range you need and I will change the generator arguments (`--samples`, `--fov`, `--range`).
